Chapter 964 Chapter 22 Tearing Apart The Universe (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 964  Chapter 22 Tearing Apart the Universe (Please Subscribe)

"Myriad Transformation, the Robber Clan didn't agree?" The heart of the ultimate being from the Prison Tribe clutched with apprehension.

If things had gone smoothly, and the two ultimates from the Robber Clan had agreed to confront the Galaxy Master, the Myriad Transformation Queen wouldn't be looking like this.

"Exactly."

"They flat out rejected me," she said.

The Myriad Transformation Queen was somewhat powerless, as she had been hustled out before she could even speak by the two ultimates of the Robber Clan.

The two ultimates from the Robber Clan didn't even give her a chance to speak, obviously not considering opposing the Galaxy Master from the start.

"How is that possible?"

The ultimate being from the Prison Tribe found it inconceivable.

Logically, only with a balance among the great powers can the Robber Clan live most comfortably.

If these peak tribal powers were to fall, wouldn't the Robber Clan be next?

Don't the Robber Clan understand such basic 'teeth-chattering' logic?

"I'm not sure either," said the Myriad Transformation Queen as she shook her head.

She truly couldn't understand; if the Robber Clan had intended to leverage this situation to make demands, they would at least have given her a chance to speak.

But that did not happen.

Neither the Myriad Transformation Queen nor the ultimates of the Robber Clan, nor the other Second Layer ultimates, were aware that the Robber Clan had already shown goodwill to the Galaxy Master ahead of time.

The Robber Clan not only did not participate in the plot against the Galaxy Master, but they had also preemptively informed the Galaxy Master of their plans.

In this case, should the Galaxy Master ascend to the Second Layer, the Robber Clan was less likely to suffer.

Most critically, the two ultimates of the Robber Clan had speculated that the Galaxy Master might be the reincarnation of a certain unparalleled Great Saint, so how could they dare to join other peak tribal powers in opposing the Galaxy Master?

That was the unparalleled Great Saint, an invincible being who roamed across the Chaos Void.

After a long while.

One of the Second Layer ultimates spoke up.

"So what do we do now?"

As soon as this was said.

The many Second Layer ultimates around looked at each other in dismay.

What to do?

What could they do?

If the two ultimates from the Robber Clan in the Path Splitting Realm indeed do not wish to intervene.

Then their side would completely lose the biggest foundation to contend with the Galaxy Master.

As for starting a full-scale war against human civilization? Indeed, that's a way, but the practical implementation is far too difficult.

The initiation of the war would consume a lot of time, particularly a total war, the major peak tribal powers might need hundreds or thousands of years to prepare.

By the time so long has passed, the Galaxy Master would likely have already made the ultimate assault, rendering it meaningless.

And several dozen Supreme Beings making a move to strike at the human civilization's territory is also not very realistic.

The nine Supreme Beings of human civilization do not even need to fight head-on; they can simply hide within their Clan Suppression Weapons.

Moreover, the Second Layer ultimates also do not wish to do so, for if they really pushed the human civilization's nine Supreme Beings into a corner, what if they fought back desperately at the cost of their lives? Could their side come out unharmed?

The only use of doing this would be to disrupt the Galaxy Master's attempt at the ultimate ascension, but how much could they actually disrupt?

"Actually, there is another way," one of the ultimates from the Tianyu Clan spoke up at this moment.

Upon hearing this, the surrounding Second Layer ultimates' spirits were lifted, and they all turned their gaze towards him.

"The Galaxy Master is indeed very strong, but no matter how strong, there is still a chance of failing when making the ultimate assault," the ultimate from the Tianyu Clan slowly said: "We only need to wait for the Galaxy Master to fail the ultimate ascension."

As long as the Galaxy Master failed the ultimate ascension and completely perished, the universe's twelve peak powers would return to balance.

"Wait for the Galaxy Master to fail the ultimate ascension?" The Myriad Transformation Queen fell into silence again.

Isn't this leaving everything to the hands of an obscure fate?

After a long time, the Myriad Transformation Queen spoke, "But what if the Galaxy Master successfully ascends to the Second Layer?"

"Successfully steps into the Second Layer?" The Tianyu Clan ultimate shook his head, "Then I really have no other options."

...

Although the way spoken by this ultimate from the Tianyu Clan isn't truly a way.

In a certain sense, it is also the only hope for all the Second Layer ultimates.

When making the ultimate assault, one must face backlash and suppression, not only from the long river of time but from the entire universe as well.

No matter how strong your life essence is, there is always a possibility of complete annihilation.

And this is the only method for the current Galaxy Master to be completely annihilated.

...

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan is sitting cross-legged.

At this moment, all aspects of him have reached the pinnacle, perfection. He could attempt the ultimate ascension immediately.

"The Myriad Realms Gate."

Lin Yuan's mind sank into his sea of consciousness, gazing at the majestic and towering Myriad Realms Gate.

At the moment, the first original world's coordinates faintly emerged, surrounded by an endless, boundless world no less vast than the Chaos Void, the aura of vast land flowing through it.

"Once I ascend to the Second Layer, and everything settles down, I'll carry out the twelfth traversal," Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Why wait until everything was stable to perform the next traversal? The flow of time in the original world is the same as in the Chaos Void; a year there is about three hundred years in the universe.

If Lin Yuan stayed in that original world for a few years, hundreds or thousands of years would have passed in the main universe.

Hence, Lin Yuan must ensure there are no hidden dangers on his side before undertaking the twelfth traversal.

Otherwise, what if something happened in the universe midway through the traversal – wouldn't the traversal have to be abandoned?

In the previous eleven traversals, the flow of time in the universe was slower than in those traversal worlds – even if Lin Yuan stayed longer in the traversal worlds, not much time would have gone by in the universe.

"I feel that after stepping into the Second Layer, some kind of transformation will occur to the Myriad Realms Gate?" Lin Yuan felt somewhat expectant; his understanding of space-time had reached the Seventh Realm, hence discovering the coordinates of thirty-three original worlds deep within the Myriad Realms Gate.

And once his life level completely steps into the Second Layer, many more secrets of the Myriad Realms Gate will likely be unveiled before him.

After all, even though a life at the Second Layer level still cannot handle the Myriad Realms Gate's main body, it should be able to receive a lot of information and even abilities concerning the Myriad Realms Gate.

"Let's begin the ascension now."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and immediately began to contact the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization.

For any life form, the ultimate ascension is crucial, it's best not to be disturbed by anything.

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan met with the nine ultimate beings of human civilization.

"Galaxy Master you..."

The Xuanyuan Supreme looked at Lin Yuan, faintly guessing something in his mind.

Since the battle between the Galaxy Master and the ancestor of the Tianyu Clan, none of the nine ultimate beings have disturbed him.

They wanted to give Lin Yuan more time to adjust his condition.

Now Lin Yuan was actively contacting them...

"I plan to make a breakthrough to the ultimate level."

Lin Yuan nodded, having comprehended the Seventh Realm of space-time and nurtured the Chaos Rule, among other achievements.

Lin Yuan believed he had done everything to perfection.

"Making a breakthrough to the ultimate level."

All nine ultimate beings simultaneously looked at Lin Yuan.

Even though they had anticipated this possibility, they couldn't help feeling anxious.

It was even more nerve-wracking than when they themselves had attempted the ultimate breakthrough.

The nine ultimate beings were very clear about the impact it would have on human civilization if Lin Yuan stepped into the Twelfth Layer.

At the very least, it would lead human civilization to become the strongest force in the universe, with the other eleven peak tribes having to unite to barely withstand it.

If he were stronger, it would mean dominating the entire universe, with no one to contest his authority.

This was much more significant than the birth of one more ultimate being or even five or ten ultimate beings in human civilization.

Even if human civilization gained ten more ultimate beings, or twenty, at most they could force the few peak tribe forces to unite.

But Lin Yuan becoming a being of the Twelfth Layer? That would mean the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, indisputably the strongest combat force within the universe.

The Robber Clan, having only two abnormal supremes at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm who couldn't fully exert their strength, could occupy the richest territories with the smallest population.

Human civilization gaining one more supreme force in the peak of the Path Splitting Realm?

The nine ultimate beings were somewhat unable to imagine it.

"Galaxy Master, why not wait a bit longer? It's still far from the great doom of the universe, there's no rush,"

The Xuanyuan Supreme suggested after some thought.

He was genuinely worried about Lin Yuan failing the ultimate breakthrough.

Life that fails the ultimate breakthrough cannot be resurrected by the Twelfth Layer.

Actually, the Xuanyuan Supreme faintly realized that even if Lin Yuan didn't fail, as long as he perished, they, those of the Twelfth Layer, couldn't resurrect him.

To resurrect past lives that have died by reversing the Twelfth Layer flow essentially means using one's own vast life essence to fish for the life imprint deep within the river of time.

But Lin Yuan?

The Xuanyuan Supreme had personally witnessed him dragging down the ancestor of the Tianyu Clan with just one hand within the river of time.

If Lin Yuan were to perish, the ultimate beings of the Twelfth Layer would simply not be able to fish up Lin Yuan's life imprint, even if it was within the river of time.

"There's no need to wait."

Lin Yuan shook his head.

His condition was at its peak now, and it would be the same even after a thousand or ten thousand years.

Without stepping into the Twelfth Layer, even if Lin Yuan went through the twelfth transit, he would still have to attempt the Twelfth Layer breakthrough in that source world.

Instead of that, it would be better to attempt the breakthrough in the Main Universe.

"No problem," the Xuanyuan Supreme nodded.

"The nine of us will definitely protect you with all our strength."

The Xuanyuan Supreme solemnly said.

"Thank you."

Lin Yuan said.

...

Within human civilization territory.

Lin Yuan's figure appeared.

The next moment, the presence of the nine ultimate beings faintly emerged around him.

Before starting the ultimate breakthrough, Lin Yuan would definitely inform the ultimate beings of his breakthrough location.

"Let's begin."

Lin Yuan merged into the depths of the Spatial Layers and sat down cross-legged.

"First, let's use the Heart of Space-Time." With a thought from Lin Yuan, the Heart of Space-Time obtained from the Demon Jade Space appeared before him.

The Heart of Space-Time, a treasure prepared by the Moyu Tower Master for the Direct Disciple, was meant to aid in the breakthrough to the Twelfth Layer.

Although Lin Yuan believed that he had reached the ultimate foundation and that his breakthrough to the ultimate level was almost a sure success, he did not mind having an extra layer of security.

Hum.

Lin Yuan swallowed the Heart of Space-Time and immediately felt his heartbeat change, seemingly fusing completely with the surrounding space-time.

At this moment, Lin Yuan was space-time, and space-time was Lin Yuan.

"So that's how it is."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

He now roughly understood how the Heart of Space-Time improved the probability of a Twelfth Layer breakthrough.

One aspect was extending his own time spent atop the river of time.

The other was merging with space-time, thus reducing the backlash pressure from the river of time and even the universe.

His thoughts moving,

Lin Yuan closed his eyes.

Then,

Lin Yuan released the suppression of his life essence's transition.

...

"Hmm?"

The nine ultimate beings of human civilization slightly changed their expressions.

They faintly felt the universe's void changing, as if reverting to its origin, as if returning to the beginning.

Whoosh.

The next moment.

The cosmic void within the visual range of the nine ultimate beings was directly torn apart.
